comment: While the professor is personable and approachable, the lecture delivery for HS 250 can be difficult to follow. The teaching style often lacks a clear structure, making it challenging to identify key takeaways during class. As a result, success in this course requires a high level of independent self-study and heavy reliance on the textbook.
The easiest class just do well on the blackboard quizzes. no major assignments until the final which is a paper and can basically be on any topic. Def take Dr. Oza she's great
